'''Aktik''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] that lived at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During that time the Jawa accompanied a spacer to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and possibly other [[Planet/Legends|planets]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Keep an eye on your salvage with this lively little Jawa around!|In-game shop description|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
Aktik was a [[:w:c:cwa:Companion|companion]] for players in the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. The Jawa sidekick could be bought for 300 [[:w:c:cwa:Station Cash|Station Cash]] from the [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] [[80-T5]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] or via the in-game shop. He would follow the player around on their adventures.
